WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_15.avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'
) subq_15
